title: retail ai tools are becoming a distribution problem
author: Plastic-Bluejay5047
selftext: The brokerage push into retail AI trading tools this week feels less like a signal breakthrough and more like a new way to funnel the same crowded trades into markets faster. If thousands of accounts get similar sentiment scores, summaries, and entry ideas, the useful part may be spotting where that consensus is already priced in
